[h1][b]MORE IMAGES BELOW!!![/b][/h1]
[h3][b]NEW GEAR SYSTEM, DUAL STRONGHOLD BOSSES, COSMETICS & MORE!!![/b][/h3]

Greetings Maiden Nation! This is your Maiden Commander speaking!

We couldn't be happier to show our progress on the upcoming expansion League of Maidens "The Realm of Shadows"! To date we are 80% complete on the expansion making consistent progress on the build daily and we cannot wait for you all to play!

Until then, we would like to share some information on just a few of the huge content and system additions coming in the next expansion. Let's jump right in!

[i][b]NEW GEAR PROGRESSION SYSTEM[/b][/i]

We are extremely happy to announce the completion of the work on a new Enchantment System that will allow players to take any piece of existing gear (T1-T3) and enchant the gear with certain buffs which will apply to certain enemies. The first of the available enchantments is called "The Corruption". Players will be able to place their gear within a Shadow Forge located in the new TROS zone to Corrupt their gear from +1 to +15 across (3) different tiers (T1-T3) with gear dropping within the Realm of Shadows having a possibility of being corrupt from Tier 1 +1 up to +10 which makes for anywhere from 35 to 45 levels of progression for each gear piece. Gear corruption levels are separated into 3 tiers requiring players to need T3 gear with Corruption Tier 3 and Corruption Level +15 on all (6) gear pieces to get a maximum of 90% damage buff on all Shadow enemies within the Realm of Shadows. This along with a 10% damage boost from a newly added Dark Essence (more info to come) will provide a combined 100% damage bonus for all Shadow enemies and Stronghold Bosses located within the new expansion. Be sure to check out a preview image of the updated UI which features the corruption tier and level of gear below.

[i][b]CORRUPTION VISUAL EFFECTS[/b][/i]

We are adding a cool new feature which visualizes the corruption level on your character in four stages. As players increase their corruption levels across all gear pieces their character will begin to take on a more sinister look which will help make it immediately clear how corrupt a player has become. This visual effect is free for all players and it can be combined with existing aura effects. Lastly this visual effect can be toggled on and off should a player not wish to alter their characters appearance based on corruption levels within the character customization interface. Be sure to check out a preview image of the progression of the corruption visual effects below.

[i][b]NEW DUAL STRONGHOLD BOSSES[/b][/i]

We couldn't be happier to announce that the upcoming TROS update will feature for the first time a dual Stronghold Boss fight with the new Shadow Ako & Shadow Iko Tier 2 boss fight. I recently had a chance to take on this Tier 2 boss challenge and I must say it is by far the most fun fight in the entire game. Some of the random and amazingly kickass moments that occur with these two twins will create awesome and memorable gameplay moments for years to come. Be sure to check out a preview image of the Atonement UI featuring Shadow Ako & Shadow Iko below.

[i][b]NEW PREMIUM & IN-GAME EARNABLE COSMETICS[/b][/i]

We've added a total of (9) new outfits (some of which we are previewing today) and a host of new premium cosmetics including (2) new shadow mounts and much more. We've also added over 16+ (and counting) new non-premium cosmetics which we won't be previewing today but we will for sure preview before the release of the expansion.

More will be revealed soon along with previews of a new game mode and much more in the next expansion. Expect more frequent updates on our progress as we draw closer to the release of TROS and feel free to ask any questions you'd like in the comments section. We're happy to answer what we can that won't spoil the surprise!

That's it for now! Thank you again SO MUCH! WE SINCERELY APPRECIATE EACH AND EVERY ONE OF YOU!!! 

Have an amazing weekend everyone!

- Maiden Commander

Review the build/patch/hotfix list below for a detailed list of resolved issues in the associated build/patch/hotfix. 

Phase 2 of server migration

2 - Transition online beauty album functionality to use with new migrated server
3 - Album data (Title, Download count, ect.) to work with new migrated server 


The Realm of Shadows expansion
------------------------------

3 - Implemented entrance for strongholds and the stronghold segments for players to run through

9 - 12 new enemy mob types have been added. (10) new enemy variations and (2) brand new mob types with unique mechanics.

13 - (2) new outfits along with a Gauntlet and Cape variant have been added.
14 - Timing for the new melee has been adjusted to improve it's feel.
15 - (3) New skills Shadow Blade (Q Key Skill), Shadow Strike (E Key Skill) and Shadow Turret (R Key Skill) have been added.
16 - Skill coloring for all new skills have been completed.
17 - Mob spawn locations for TROS strongholds have been adjusted.
18 - (2) New wing variants have been added.
19 - Dark Essence and Dark Matter items have been added.
20 - Initial UI for the Dark Portal mini-game has been completed.
21 - Updated the build with the new TROS theme song.
22 - Start page background updated with new TROS background>
23 - TROS Segments re-organized to provide better direction for each entrance.
24 - Cleaned up positions for the ammo crates in the segments.
25 - Broken rock base added for new Shadow Worm enemy.
26 - A second new melee has been added. New melee associated Q key skill has been added.
27 - New Gun Mod has been added.
28 - In-game UI updated to reflect The Realm of Shadows Expansion.
29 - New enemy type "Void Guardian" has been added. This will represent a brand new type of mechanic for players running TROS strongholds.
30 - Newly added Gun Mod is Rapid Fire Shotgun Mod (Almost 2x Speed Boost).
31 - Newly added Melee is Dual Pistols completely re-engineered from the ground up.
32 - New Item Dark Arcane has been added. Used to unlock skills and other items.
33 - New skill Kill Shot (E Key Pistol Skill) has been added.
34 - Reduce load times -> Adjusted the wait times for on start up and verified that the extended wait time behaved the same as before with the reduced wait time. Start up time reduced from 1:45-1:50 to 0:50-0:55
35 - Applying Sexy Bunny outfit to a look and restarting the game causes the all the looks to be set to the last look that you had set before you closed the game fix.
36 - Unlock skill window does not close if you close the skill loadout with the skill loadout shortcut. You can still pay the cost but the prompt stays open and deducts the resource/currency and the skill does not unlock fix
37 - Dark Essence (adds 10% damage buff to all shadow enemies) has been updated to provide a second gauntlet charge while in use. If Dark Essence is active and a player activates their gauntlet a second charge will be added allowing for a second use of the gauntlet.
38 - Gear Corruption has been added. Players are now able to enchant new and existing gear. The first available enchantment will be "The Corruption". Players can add Corruption levels (+1 to +15) to their gear which provides a corruption visual effect as well as providing damage buffs to all shadow enemies. Gear corruption level is separated into 3 tiers requiring players to need T3 gear with +15 corruption on all 6 gear pieces to get the maximum 90% damage bonus. 10% from dark essence for a combined 100% damage bonus.
39 - Corruption visual effect has been added. This visual effect makes the player look more sinister as their gear corruption levels are increased. This visual effect can be toggled on and off inside the character customization interface.
40 - Two new tattoos have been added.
41 - (5) new outfits have been added along with (6) head gear pieces.
42 - (3) new Stronghold bosses have been added. Queen Ar'Kanis, Shadow Ako & Shadow Iko.
43 - All new Stonghold boss melee attacks have been added.
44 - All new Stronghold boss attack mechanics have been added.
45 - Dual Stronghold boss system has been added (The most fun boss fight ever).
46 - Dark Void mini-game has been renamed to The Dark Portal "Hold the Line". Will be accessible from the Desktop once players complete the TROS storyline.

[i]If you are receiving this message, then it might already be too late.

What have we done? We created monsters in order to destroy the ones that had us in peril. With help from the warmaiden program created by General Michaels, we were able to narrowly avoid a possible extinction level event. We were able to destroy the Fall.

Atonia wanted us dead, simply because of who we were. She would have succeeded if it weren’t for the warmaidens. After the dust settled, the Champions stood tall, and we rose on their shoulders. We sent them to defeat titans, and in doing so the warmaidens became our gods. But being gods was the furthest thing from their minds. They wanted what all great warriors want after war...peace. They divided the world into five different regions where each could protect the populous in case of emerging threats.

As the years went on, the warmaidens regressed into protecting their own regions. Each had their own vision of how to keep it safe. Slowly over the course of time… they stopped caring for one another. The people… their factions… their saviors. Resources began to dwindle. Soon after, came bloodshed. What irony. In the end, we did to ourselves what The Fall could not.

General Michaels' plan for a world order disintegrated in front of his eyes and he blames me for its downfall. The warmaidens would not have come into power if it were not for my leadership. During the war against the warmaidens the human casualties forced General Michaels to activate a previously piloted program to create mechanized warriors using fallen warmaidens and the carcasses of the deceased Fall along with a modification to a porter technology dubbed the “Temporal device” created to transfer a being from one location to another with the addition of time displacement. Its purpose was to go back in time and eliminate Atonia before she came to power, but the Champions stopped her before it became fully operational.

In the end General Michael’s effort to combat the warmaidens using his android army failed leaving him with one final option. To use his mechanized horde along with the Temporal device to slaughter anyone associated with the warmaiden program. He believes by killing us, the warmaidens rise to power will come to an end.    My name is Major Frost, and this will be my final message. I’m going into the past to stop General Michael's’ heinous attack.    

The race to save a future in peril begins now...[/i]

We are so happy to announce that patch 1.5.7a is officially live and ready for updating. If you are not seeing the update please exit and relaunch Steam. What's new you ask? Revision: LoM v1.5.7a
Release Date: 4/23/21
Patch Size: 20 Issues addressed 

Review the build/patch/hotfix list below for a detailed list of resolved issues in the associated build/patch/hotfix. 

1 - Fixed a bug that would cause Steam users accounts to get out of sync appearing to not show the correct purchases under specific conditions. 
2 - Added the ability for players to Factory Reset their account to wipe local data.
3 - Added the ability for players to Clear Steam Cloud data.
4 - Added a warning notification for players that enabled Streamer mode and run a streaming application while Nudity Everywhere and Nudity for All are enabled.
5 - Improved the warning screen that details if a players account does not meet the minimum requirements. 
6 - Removed a function that blocked users from entering the game if they failed the minimum requirements under certain conditions.
7 - Fixed a bug that caused Force Field to not work correctly with the new blocking logic.
8 - Implemented our more complicated fix for the cloud loading issue which will hopefully resolve the remaining users seeing the issue. For clarity we have found that this is a common issue for games that are playing .mp4 videos using the .H264 codec.
9 - Fixed bug that caused the base damage for all pistol skills to not scale properly when upgrading using the Load Out. This change makes it harder to balance this skill. We've selected a new base and will balance from there.
10 - Fixed a bug that caused textures to move on the body when using Bat Swarm.
11 - Fixed a bug that caused lower end systems to crash when using Bat Swarm.
12 - Fixed a bug that caused the new blocked logic to be applied to Stronghold Bosses.
13 - Fixed a bug that caused Large Projectile to deal more damage than intended.
14 - Fixed a bug that caused skills to not cast under specific conditions. Thanks to @Santiclause for providing this clean repro for us to fix. https://streamable.com/qpjbgo
15 - Removed the 4th Dual pistol attack animation that has players stuck in place for an extended period of time.
16 - Fixed a bug that caused the Dual Pistol reticle to always show as red instead of only being red when hovering over a valid target.
17 - Improved the Dual Pistol reticle to animate similar to the other rifles.
18 - Removed the forced camera zoom for Dual Pistols and all Pistol Skills. 
19 - Made various improvements to gun melee and related gun skills to make the cancel earlier to not keep players stuck in place.
20 - Made a change to the SIZE MATTERS skill to place double stomps on Left Mouse and Double Arm Ground Smash on Right Mouse. The idea here is to separate these attack and also leave room for additional attacks in the future like Hook and Uppercut Punches for Giant v. Giant battles.

BUILD NOTES

We finally have a confirmed fix for the infinite cloud loading issue. Turned out to be a bug with the engine that we had to work around. We're very excited to get this fix out in the next patch to allow access to everyone that has encountered this issue. With that said I would like to thank @JenoraFeuer, @TitanWarfareTP and @NeoxX / beatdowncore from our Discord. Three amazing Maiden Nation Soldiers that stepped up to help us by providing clean and informative details on the bug, consistent repros and conducted testing for the many builds it took to get the issue fixed. Working in this fashion helped us to significantly speed up the time to resolution. Thank you!

notes.title: League of Maidens v1.1.4a Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Revision: LoM v1.1.4a Patch Notes
Release Date: Friday June 9th (9:00pm EST - Private Alpha Group Only)
Patch Size: 46 issue addressed

Review the build/patch/hotfix list below for a detailed list of resolved issues in the associated build/patch/hotfix. Please post any bugs that you may find in our Bug Reports & Supports section. Lastly, feel free to join our community on discord to discuss the game and what you would like to see added!

Patch Notes: League of Maidens v1.1.4 Alpha

1 – Revamped the city models to optimize and make them look better to increase performance.

2 – Added (13) new dance routine emotes each 2-3 minutes long. Very… very exciting!!!

3 – Added new selectable ‘Desert Stage’ when going to war.

4 – Added a new gameplay mechanic that allows players to revive a fellow war maiden if they die during a lane push.

5 – Added a new gameplay mechanic that drops HP, MP and XP crates when destroying tanks and jets.

6 – Adjusted the camera location for sprint running with the dynamic camera setting.

7 – Fixed an issue where projectile force was not being applied to soldiers and dead bodies.

8 – Fixed training mini-game sounds.

9 – Fixed an issue where soldiers were not teleporting to the new lane when battle stage ends.

10 – Fixed an issue with not being able to preview Model B outfits in the shop.

11 - Disabled Ambient Occlusion and Action Camera by default.

12 – Changed Weather and Time to “DYNAMIC” by default.

13 – Fixed an issue with Dynamic time setting not starting at 8:00am

14 – Fixed an issue with “cannot connect to the server” if the player cleared their data folder.

15 – Fixed an issue with pop-up damage not showing when shooting soldiers.

16 – Fixed an issue with transformation not working for Divinian war maidens.

17 – Fixed an issue with melee not denting cars.

18 – Fixed an issue with thunderstorm rain effect not working in game and in cinematography mode.

19 – Added the ability for players to enter RGB values in the character customization color picker.

20 – Added a ground target for Raging Storm and Lightning Strike skills.

21 - Removed the Bow and Arrow arc projection UI indicator and replaced it with the standard cross hair.

22 – Fixed an exploit that allowed players to slide large distances when using melee in Growth form.

23 – Fixed an issue that prevented the camera from adjusting when you are using the M2 attack while existing Growth form.

24 – Changed “Immortals Killed” to “War Maidens Killed” in the match results screen.

25 – Fixed a graphical glitch that caused the war maidens upper body to be invisible when setting the effect level below 3.

26 – Improved the explosion effects for war ships when they attack the enemy base in rush stage.

27 – Fixed an issue that prevented the base core from disappearing after it is destroyed at the end of the match.

28 – Fixed a bug caused when you are attacked by the dragon during a sprint grab.

29 – Fixed a bug that caused the war maidens force field to get stuck after players death from a turret attack.

30 – Fixed an issue that caused the “War Maiden has been killed” UI element to get stuck when entering cinematography mode.

31 – Reduced damage level for Burning Crusher skill. DAMAGE – Lvl 1. 600 | Lvl 2. 800 | Lvl 3. 1000 | Lvl 4. 1200 | Lvl 5. 1400

32 – Fixed an issue that caused the player to lose momentum and drop down immediately after Burning Crusher.

33 – Fixed an issue that randomly caused Burning Crusher to not move forward at all or delay before moving forward.

34 – Added expiration times for Conjured Turrets. LASTING TIME – Lvl 1. 30 seconds | Lvl 2. 45 seconds | Lvl 3. 60 seconds | Lvl 4. 90 seconds | Lvl 5. 120 seconds.

35 – Added expiration times for Conjured Healing/Magic Posts. LASTING TIME – Lvl 1. 30 seconds | Lvl 2. 45 seconds | Lvl 3. 60 seconds | Lvl 4. 90 seconds | Lvl 5. 120 seconds.

36 – Added expiration times for Conjured Traps. LASTING TIME – Lvl 1. 60 seconds | Lvl 2. 90 seconds | Lvl 3. 120 seconds | Lvl 4. 180 seconds | Lvl 5. 240 seconds.

37 – Fixed an issue that caused tanks to be offset from the starting point during rush stage.

38 – Updated War Maiden transform logic to replenish health to 100% and double defense stat after transformation.

39 – Fixed post processing effects for “You Win” and “You Lose” camera after match completion.

40 – Removed the disabled “Whipping Lash” as a skill reward for chests.

41 – Fixed an issue that caused the war ships to only attack one turret during rush stage. The left war ship now attacks the left turret and the right war ship attacks the right turret.

42 – Changed spawning soldier count during battle stage start and after the lane crystal is destroyed. During battle stage start each side spawns with 10 soldiers. After lane crystal is destroyed the winning side (the side that destroyed the crystal) spawns 50% more soldiers and the losing side spawns 50% less soldiers.

43 – Fixed an issue that caused the explosion from the “Small Projectile” attack to be offset to the right of the target.

44 – Fixed an issue that prevented damage to the Mech during rush stage when attacking certain sections of the model.

45 – Fixed an issue that caused the Model B war maiden to sometimes load without a face.

46 – Disabled the “REPLAY” tab while in training mode.

47 - Fixed a resolution setting issue that caused the player to get locked out of the configuration panel. 

48 - Changed Ready Stage to 10 seconds instead of 60 seconds to speed up match start.

49 - Increased FPS cap from 60fps to 120fps.

50 - Fixed an issue that caused Netherian players to land offset to the right on top of a tank using the launcher in Rush Stage.

51 - Fixed an issue that sometimes caused War Maiden AI to fall through the floor of the base during Ready Stage.

52 - Fixed an issue that caused the player to die over and over again in a ragdolled state during the battle. 

53 - Updated Asset count warning to only show when any of the players asset counts reach zero.

54 - Changed the Ready Stage message to be more descriptive about using the launcher.

55 - Removed 'Dynamic Hair' setting. It is now always enabled.

56 - Changed Resolution settings to only offer 16:9 or higher resolutions. 4:3 no longer supported.

Known Issues: 

Cannot Disable Motion Blur. We will have this resolved by the next build.
Building destruction has been disabled as we are revamping this system to optimize it and make it look better.
A crash may occur during gameplay when a turret is destroyed. We will have this resolved by the next build.
A slight camera stuttering may occur when moving at high speeds. We will have this resolved by the next build.
Player can be separated from the war maiden they are trying to revive. We will have this resolved by the next build.
Camera goes through the ground when initiating Weak projectile attacks at high angles. We will have this resolved by the next build.

Next Patch Priorities: 

In-Game Help/Guides, Bug Fixes, Continued Performance & Optimization and War Maiden AI improvements.

Release Date: Saturday, May 20th (3:00pm EST)
Patch Size: 11 issue addressed

Review the build/patch/hotfix list below for a detailed list of resolved issues in the associated build/patch/hotfix. Please post any bugs that you may find in our Bug Reports & Supports section. JOIN US ON DISCORD - https://discord.gg/5TU2NX9

Patch Notes: League of Maidens v1.1.3 Alpha

1 – Improved the soldier AI logic and made optimization changes to help with overall performance.

2 – Improved physics logic and made optimization changes to help with overall performance.

3 – Improved memory management and made optimization changes to help with overall performance.

4 – Improved the method used to store and retrieve war maiden blueprints.

5 – Optimized blueprint files reducing them by 40% of the original file size to improve loading performance.

6 – Increased the chance to get perks and skills from chests.

7 – Lowered the overall death timer penalty.

8 – Updated the game executable name.

9 – Fixed a bug where tanks starting point were in the wrong position during rush stage.

10 – Disabled VSYNC by default.

11 – Fixed a bug that caused audio for sound effects to cut out during intense battle scenes.

Next Patch Priorities: Continued Performance & Optimization, War Maiden AI improvements, content addition.
